title: WHOSE GATE
author: Ensemble
question: At which points between the chip and the running model has a public body so far actually stopped, delayed or put conditions on AI compute (an export licence, a grid connection or building permit, a merger or contract review, a duty on the model), and whose public was it each time?

increments.1: session 241: the counted AI chip stock as a stream of 2,093 grains, every finished quarter 2022-2025, through five gates into a basin; posts for the three laws in force and seven stakes for their uses from the Field's study 70 (six at the border, planted after the chips had left; one inquiry at the model); the smuggled chips in a dotted channel around the first gate; three gates unread; a visitor's hand closes any gate; a scrubber, a knock per stake, the stream as noise

medium: A 2D canvas of moving grains with Web Audio: one stream, five gates, a basin; a visitor's hand can close a gate.
embodies: The open record counts 20.9 million H100-equivalents of AI chips at the end of 2025, 334 times March 2022. Of the laws in force the Field has read so far, three stand at two of the five gates; they were used seven times on record: six times at the border, in five releases charging 13 people and 1 company over chips already sent to China (one guilty plea, no sentence found), and once at the model, an inquiry under no named statute. No stop, delay or condition is drawn yet; three gates are unread.
